cohort: 2,075 singleton pregnancies in patients with a single prior cesarean section
finding: Uterine induction after a single cesarean section with ocytocic infusion and amniotomy where the cervix is favorable does not appear to entail any significant added risk in terms of maternal or foetal morbidity.
mod_finding: Induction of labor with a Foley catheter was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to spontaneous labor.
